answers.why: The LORD will do something in Israel that will shock everyone who hears it.
All Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognizes Samuel as the LORD's prophet.
Samuel's word comes to all Israel, the national community.
Israel goes out to battle the Philistines and encamps beside Ebenezer.
The Philistines array their forces against Israel in battle.
Israel suffers defeat with about four thousand men killed.
Israel's elders discuss the people's defeat and seek the ark for their camp.
All Israel shouts when the ark enters the military camp.
Israel is defeated by the Philistines and its men flee to their tents.
Thirty thousand foot soldiers fall from Israel in battle.
The messenger reports Israel's flight and a great slaughter among the people.
Eli had judged Israel for forty years.
Glory departs from Israel because the nation's ark has been captured.
The capture of God's ark explains why glory has departed from Israel.
